summary: HYPE ~$79.5 (+1.1% 24h). Kinetiq set Elysium L2 mainnet for 9 Nov (HYPE as gas). Mentions jumped sharply today (~15x yesterday's hourly rate), driven by the Elysium date and a story that retail wallet-app users lost ~$280M on Hyperliquid, mostly to fees. Price has not run, so this is news rather than post-pump hype, but the retail-loss angle and heavy leverage keep it near neutral.
